claim_scope: Four-turn synthetic two-page digital text PDF with one simple district-by-year table. This does not validate scans, nested tables, spanning headers, or multiple candidate regions.

antigravity_reference.observed_failure: The default product located the staged PDF but the Google model service returned PERMISSION_DENIED 403 before any answer or workspace output. Quota inspection did not indicate ordinary exhaustion.
antigravity_reference.comparison_limit: This establishes a product-path reliability failure on the server, not that Gemini cannot perform the PDF task. A paired Antigravity GUI replay remains unavailable in the SSH environment.

stronger_non_antigravity_reference.strengths: Correct values, six-point gap, durable two-year page, traceable four-row export, polished offline page.

development_failures_retained: rep-01 lost 2022 after the one-year comparison request and exported only two rows.
rep-02 re-percented an already-percent metric, producing 100% values and a zero gap.
rep-03 calculated the correct gap but left all four districts on the comparison page before the final turn.
rep-04 used one automatic repair to focus the durable result on the requested two districts.
decision: The validated split path beats the observed Antigravity product path and the stronger Cline/Qwen reference on this narrow digital-PDF case. Advance it, but require scanned and multi-region PDF cases before any general PDF claim.
